sources.summary: On the high, sandy bluffs overlooking Peconic Bay, a new community is emerging as an alternative to the ultra-glamorous Hamptons scene. Along this coastline, kitesurfing, paddleboarding, reading and long dinners with family and friends carry the most weight. The community here values timeless design, a connection to nature, respect for context and culture and family time above all.
